'''Mikashikiyahime''' (三炊屋媛, dates unknown) was an ancient Japanese woman.

== Overview ==
In the {{ill|Kojiki|en|Kojiki|qid=Q813031|lt=Kojiki|1=Kojiki}}, she is referred to as '''Tomiyabime''' (登美夜毘売), while the {{ill|Nihon Shoki|en|Nihon Shoki|qid=Q813935|lt=Nihon Shoki|1=Nihon Shoki}} calls her '''Mikashikiyahime''' (三炊屋媛), '''Torimiyahime''' (鳥見屋媛), or '''Nagasunehime''' (長髄媛). She is also known by names such as '''Mishikiyahime''' (御炊屋姫), '''Kushitama-hime-no-Mikoto''' (櫛玉姫命), or '''Kushitama-hime''' (櫛玉比売命).

== Lineage ==
Mikashikiyahime was the sister of {{ill|Nagatsuhiko|lt=Nagatsuhiko|lt=Nagasunehiko|ja|長髄彦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nagasunehiko}} and the wife of {{ill|Nigihayahi|ja|饒速日命|lt=Nigihayahi no Mikoto|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nigihayahi|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to QID FIXED|qid=Q10949054|1=Nigihayahi|lt=Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto}}. Together, they had a son, {{ill|Umashimaji|lt=Umashimaji|lt=Umashimaji no Mikoto|ja|宇摩志麻遅命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Umashimaji no Mikoto|qid=Q10946169}}, who became the ancestral deity of the {{ill|Mononobe clan|en|Mononobe clan|qid=Q1755836|lt=Mononobe clan|1=Mononobe clan}} and {{ill|Hozumi clan|ja|穂積氏|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hozumi clan}}.<ref name="#3"/>

== Shrines ==
Mikashikiyahime is enshrined at several locations:
* {{ill|Ishikiri Tsurugiya Shrine|ja|石切剣箭神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ishikiri Tsurugiya Shrine}}: Within the {{ill|Upper Shrine (Ishikiri Tsurugiya Shrine)|ja|石切剣箭神社#上之社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Upper Shrine (Ishikiri Tsurugiya Shrine)|1=Ishikiri Tsurugiya Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11585189}}, specifically at the Tomireisha and {{ill|Fudō Shrine|ja|婦道神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fudō Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (Higashi-Osaka City, Osaka Prefecture).
* {{ill|Yataza Kushitama Hikojinja|ja|矢田坐久志玉比古神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yataza Kushitama Hikojinja|1=Yata ni Imasu Kushitamahiko Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11584205}}
* {{ill|Kushitamahime-no-Mikoto Shrine|ja|櫛玉比女命神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kushitamahime-no-Mikoto Shrine}}
